title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the solid as an insulator based on the specific heat behavior.

title: Final Answer for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct temperature dependence of <U^2> for both high and low temperatures.

title: Reasoning for (a)
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the relationship between specific heat and conductivity, indicating the temperature dependence.

title: Integration Setup for (b)
description: Important Criteria: The student must set up the integral correctly for calculating <U^2> using the given density of states.

title: High Temperature Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly analyze the behavior of <U^2> at high temperatures, showing it is proportional to T.

title: Low Temperature Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly analyze the behavior of <U^2> at low temperatures, providing the correct constant value.

title: Common Errors in (a)
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid incorrectly identifying the solid as a conductor based on specific heat data.

title: Common Errors in (b)
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid mistakes in the integration limits or the application of the Bose-Einstein factor.
